query:
SELECT
            id AS "id!: MovieRowId",
            uuid AS "uuid: MovieUuid",
            title,
            sort_title AS "sort_title!",
            release_year,
            tmdb_id,
            tmdb_poster_path
        FROM movies
        WHERE
            interpretation_id = ?1
            AND (?2 IS NULL OR lower(title) LIKE '%' || lower(?2) || '%')
            AND (
                NOT ?6
                OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM movie_files mf
                    WHERE mf.movie_id = movies.id AND mf.role = 'extra'
                )
            )
            AND (
                ?3 IS NULL
                OR (
                    sort_title > ?3
                    OR (sort_title = ?3 AND id >= ?4)
                )
            )
        ORDER BY sort_title, id
        LIMIT ?5;
